scope: Proposition 8.2 (A terminal one-packet trial) of the manuscript “Computing the Random 3-SAT Threshold” (preprints/Computing-the-Random-3-SAT-Threshold-September-27-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 235 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 be7bde6cd4e513e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix U > P(a, β), 0 < η, m0 < 1, and an integer J such that (1 − η)J < m0. (8.4) Choose in advance finite nonempty test sets on K(j), 0 ≤ j ≤ J, and a structural tolerance δ > 0. For every ρ > 0 there is a trial with G1 ≤ U + ρ, at most J processed blocks, and depth at most 2J + 1, which satisfies the chosen structural records and has one of the following forms: 1. the processed blocks start at the root boundary 0; 2. the processed blocks start at boundary 1, and the remaining first exponent satisfies 0 < m < m0. Every processed block has exponent width at most η.
